Convert integer class indices into one-hot vectors.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Preprocessing](../categories/preprocessing.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `OneHotEncode` |
| Search words | onehot, encode, categorical, labels |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Labels** | Labels | Yes | 1 | Integer class indices in [0, num_classes) |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **OneHot** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | One-hot tensor with shape [batch, num_classes] |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| num_classes | `num_classes` | Integer | `10` | `1-100000` | The run | Total number of target classes. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: OneHotEncode is a training preprocessing contract node; PipelineExecutor label one-hot encoding is not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a preprocessing step |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
Used when loss function expects one-hot labels.
```

## Tips

- CrossEntropyLoss doesn't need one-hot.
- Required for some custom loss functions.
